title: Doppler Personal token (dp.pt.): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: DP.PT. vs the documented lower-case dp.pt., prefix: dp.xx., a type the provider does not document, and prefix: the type spelled PT. Twin of "Doppler Personal token (dp.pt.): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of doppler-personal-token-bearer-header: prefix: DP.PT. vs the documented lower-case dp.pt.. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
